store_listing.message:
this eye-care extension enables night mode by creating dark themes for websites on the fly. darken inverts bright colors to make web pages high contrast and easier to read.

adjust brightness, contrast, the sepia filter, font preferences. enable dark mode on every web page or give websites a sepia tone. enable or disable darken for specific websites, automatically sync with system dark mode, or detect already dark websites and leave them unchanged.

darken plus unlocks a premium user interface with customizable color themes for a fee.

darken is based on dark reader, originally created in 2014. we continuously evolve alongside modern web technologies to deliver fast and reliable dark mode support for people sensitive to bright light.

by installing the extension you agree to these terms of use https://darken.org/terms/

please disable similar extensions to avoid conflicts. enjoy browsing!
